summary: Frontend-only verification of PaintOps map fix + fullscreen feature on mobile web (390x844). All 6 numbered checks PASSED. Real Leaflet tiles render on Map tab (leaflet-container=1, tile imgs=4, marker icons=13). Placeholder text absent. Expand button (scoped to live-map-container) visible; clicking opens fullscreen modal with its own Leaflet map (leaflet-container=1, markers=13) and visible close button. Close button dismisses modal and returns user to Map tab. No leaflet/L.Icon/Map-container/Cannot-read-properties errors in console. Only unrelated 401 error (auth/network resource unrelated to map).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Map fully working on web via react-leaflet. Inline map on Map tab + fullscreen modal both render OpenStreetMap tiles and 13 marker icons (matches seeded visits). Expand/close flow works. Home screen also has a map-fullscreen-btn hence scoped selector via get_by_test_id('live-map-container').get_by_test_id('map-fullscreen-btn') is required.
rca_of_issue: Previous PaintOpsMap.web.tsx used only a static placeholder. Fix replaced it with react-leaflet v5 + OSM tiles and added fullscreen Modal in both web and native variants. Verified via DOM: .leaflet-container, img.leaflet-tile, .leaflet-marker-icon all present in both inline and fullscreen views.
